description: This file defines the Product class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.Catalog namespace. The class provides methods for creating and updating product entries in an OpenCart e-commerce system, including handling product details, descriptions, categories, filters, stores, downloads, related products, attributes, options, subscriptions, discounts, specials, images, and SEO URLs.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Represents the Product model with methods to add and update product records, including handling related descriptions, categories, filters, stores, downloads, related products, attributes, options, subscriptions, discounts, specials, images, and SEO URLs in the database.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Contains methods to add, edit, copy, and delete products and their associated data in the database.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Contains methods to add, edit, copy, delete products and their associated data in the database.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Creates a new product entry in the database with provided data, setting various properties such as descriptions, categories, filters, store associations, downloads, related products, attributes, options, subscriptions, discounts, specials, images, and SEO URLs, then returns the new product's ID.

methods.name: editProduct
methods.description: Updates an existing product identified by product_id with new data, including descriptions, categories, filters, store associations, downloads, related products, attributes, options, subscriptions, discounts, specials, images, and SEO URLs.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Removes a product and all its related data, including attributes, categories, descriptions, discounts, downloads, filters, images, layout, SEO URLs, rewards, related products, reports, subscriptions, store associations, and reviews.

methods.name: copyProduct
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of an existing product with some fields reset to default, copying associated descriptions, categories, attributes, and other related data from the master product.

methods.name: addVariant
methods.description: Adds a variant (child product) overriding some properties from a master product, potentially using override data to customize fields.

methods.name: editVariant
methods.description: Edits an existing variant (child product) with new data, similar to copying but for existing product IDs.

methods.name: editVariants
methods.description: Edits multiple variants (child products) of a master product, overriding master values with specified data, converting JSON strings to arrays as needed.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves detailed data for a specific product, including descriptions, variants, and overrides, decoding JSON fields into arrays.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches a list of products based on filter criteria such as master ID, name, model, price, quantity, status, with sorting and pagination options.

methods.name: editRating
methods.description: Updates the rating value for a specified product.

methods.name: editMasterId
methods.description: Sets or updates the master ID for a specific product.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionsBySubscriptionPlanId
methods.description: Deletes subscription entries matching a specific subscription plan ID.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionsBySubscriptionPlanId
methods.description: Returns the total number of distinct products associated with a specific subscription plan ID.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Deletes all report entries related to a specified product ID.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Retrieves report data (IP, store ID, country, date added) for a specific product, with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Returns the total number of report entries for a specific product ID.

search-terms: delete product with all related data
copy product including descriptions and categories
add product variant with override data
list products with filters and sorting
